ValueSet-HIV.D.DE43.narrative: This schema validates IRI-formatted codes for the ART start type ValueSet ValueSet. Each enum value includes the system URI in the format {systemuri}#{code} to match JSON-LD enumeration IRIs. Display values are available at http://smart.who.int/hiv/ValueSet-HIV.D.DE43.displays.json. For a complete listing of all ValueSets, see artifacts.html#terminology-value-sets.
